For the next {c_number}30{/c} minutes:
{icon:bullet} Increases Intelligence by {c_yellow}100{/c} for all nearby players.
{icon:bullet} Increases Experience by {c_yellow}5%{/c}.
This is a Core Stat Incense. Only one Core Stat Incense may be active at a time. Experience Bonus does not stack with other Incenses.
